messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: high canary latency detected for runtime-canary-3 after recent deploy. Metric: 95p token latency >> 2s across multiple nodes.
Maria G.: seeing it on the perf dashboard. 95p jumped from ~120ms to ~2.1s around the deploy window.
Aj Patel: I finished the canary roll 9m ago. We changed default batch_timeout and enabled the new kernel-selector heuristics in that build.
Samir K.: quick look at logs shows repeated kernel fallback: \"kernel_select: fallback=1 reason=quant_precise_mismatch\" on several GPUs. Also KV cache hit rate collapsed.
Priya N.: CS note: two enterprise tenants in us-west are reporting timeouts at the moment. Escalating.
Taylor L.: reassigning pager to oncall now @oncall-rotation
oncall-rotation: taking this incident, standing by for triage.
Maria G.: initial mitigation plan: 1) flip canary feature flag to disable prefetch batching 2) reduce canary traffic weight 3) rollback canary build if needed.
Aj Patel: flag name is runtime.batching.prefetch. I can flip it for the canary cohort.
Maria G.: command to flip flag:
```
redwood feature-flag set --env canary runtime.batching.prefetch false --target canary
```
Samir K.: additional observation: continuous batch sizes for short prompts jumped to 512 which is causing long queueing. KV cache hit_rate dropped to single digits. Kernel selector then falls back to scalar kernels. Logs from r-09: 
```
[2026-03-10T14:12:03Z] kernel_select: quant_kernel_v2 not found -> fallback scalar
[2026-03-10T14:12:03Z] kv_cache: hit_rate 2.1% expected ~70%
[2026-03-10T14:12:03Z] batcher: batch_size 512 latency 2000ms
```
Priya N.: I'm coordinating CS comms to the affected accounts now. Will include active mitigation steps and ETA.
Taylor L.: who will execute rollback if flipping flag doesn't bring it down quickly?
Aj Patel: I'll prep rollback. Recommended: reduce canary weight first then rollback to v2.4.1 if latency doesn't recover.
Maria G.: reduce canary traffic to 10% now.
Aj Patel: running:
```
redwood deploy traffic --target canary --weight 0.1 --project runtime
```
oncall-rotation: confirm traffic reduction applied, monitoring graphs.
Samir K.: after flag flip and traffic shed, watch for KV cache hit_rate and kernel_select logs to stop showing fallback.
Maria G.: flag flip in progress.
Incident Bot: FEATURE_FLAG_UPDATED: runtime.batching.prefetch=false (target: canary) by Maria G.
Aj Patel: if we still see problems I'll rollback the canary build. Rolling back now if needed.
Aj Patel: rollback command I will run if needed:
```
redwood deploy rollback --service runtime-canary-3 --to v2.4.1 --no-canary-promote
```
Maria G.: Priya — can you draft a short CS update that we can send after rollback if we do it? Keep it crisp: cause unknown -> mitigated -> follow-up.
Priya N.: copying a draft to CS channel now.
Samir K.: graphs show latency starting to come down 2 minutes after the flag flip and traffic reduction. KV hit-rate climbing from 2% -> 48%.
Taylor L.: good sign. Do we still want to fully rollback or keep monitoring for a stabilization window?
Aj Patel: I'll keep rollback on standby. If metrics reach baseline (95p < 200ms) for 10 minutes, hold. Otherwise roll back.
Maria G.: agreed. Post-incident items: 1) tighten canary rollout heuristics to avoid aggressive batch increases for small prompts 2) add kernel-selector guard to prevent quant kernel mismatch on new builds 3) add a smoke test that validates KV cache hit_rate and kernel_select outcomes during canary.
Samir K.: I'll add an alert that triggers when continuous batch_size > 256 for prompt_length < 64.
Priya N.: CS update prepared and sent to affected tenants with an offer of credits for downtime.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE: mitigation in place — flag flipped + traffic reduced. Monitoring for stabilization.
oncall-rotation: closing pager if no regression in next 10m.
Maria G.: assign postmortem owner: Aj Patel. Please capture root cause, timeline, and remediation CLs.
Aj Patel: will do. I'll also open a PR to revert the aggressive batching heuristic and include explicit kernel compatibility checks.
Taylor L.: thanks all — good quick triage and coordination.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT_RESOLVED: latency stabilized after flag flip and traffic shed. No further action required for immediate mitigation. Creating incident ticket for postmortem.
Maria G.: schedule a blameless postmortem and include SRE, runtime, and devex to ensure the canary smoke tests cover this.
Samir K.: adding follow-up tasks to eng-runtime board now.
Priya N.: CS follow-ups logged.
Taylor L.: :thumbsup: nice response team."
